name: HC29c: Suppressed viral load
description:
Number of active ART patients whose most recent viral load test as of the end of the reporting period was performed within the preceding 12 months and whose same most recent valid viral load result was suppressed.

Criteria: The patient must have a documented ART start date, must have reached at least six months on ART by :endDate, must be in HIV care, and must satisfy the active-on-ART rule through an ART encounter during the reporting period or return_visit_date &amp;amp;gt; :endDate. The patient’s most recent actual VL episode on or before :endDate must fall within the preceding 12 months, using sample_collection_date, then viral_load_clinical_date, laboratory_result_date, and finally order_date as the VL event date; that same most recent episode must have is_valid_result = 1 and is_suppressed = 1. An older suppressed VL must not qualify the patient if a newer VL episode exists.

configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen",
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary",
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card",
    "mamba_fact_viral_load_episode"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  /* Patient has reached routine VL eligibility */
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) <= :endDate

  /* HIV patient */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  /* Active on ART */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  )

  /* Most recent actual VL within past 12 months must be suppressed */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = r.patient_id

        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 12 MONTH)

        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

        /* Actual VL test/result */
        AND (
            v.sample_collection_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.viral_load_clinical_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.laboratory_result_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.result_status = 'VALID'
        )

        /* Suppressed result only */
        AND v.result_status = 'VALID'
        AND v.is_suppressed = 1
        AND v.is_unsuppressed = 0

        /* Must be the patient's most recent actual VL */
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v2
            WHERE v2.patient_id = v.patient_id

              AND (
                  v2.sample_collection_date IS NOT NULL
                  OR v2.viral_load_clinical_date IS NOT NULL
                  OR v2.laboratory_result_date IS NOT NULL
                  OR v2.result_status = 'VALID'
              )

              AND COALESCE(
                    v2.sample_collection_date,
                    v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                    v2.laboratory_result_date,
                    v2.order_date
                  ) <= :endDate

              AND COALESCE(
                    v2.sample_collection_date,
                    v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                    v2.laboratory_result_date,
                    v2.order_date
                  ) >
                  COALESCE(
                    v.sample_collection_date,
                    v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                    v.laboratory_result_date,
                    v.order_date
                  )
        )
  );",
